can: Consigo dizer há quanto tempo faço algo, contar o que mudou na minha vida e descrever sensações fortes.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Adjetivos fortes (exhausted, amazed, furious, delighted, terrified, starving, freezing), mudanças de vida (move house, change jobs, retire).

aula.label: Regra
aula.text: com adjetivo normal use *very* (very tired). Com adjetivo forte use **really** ou **absolutely** (really exhausted, absolutely furious). Nunca "very exhausted".

**Mudanças de vida:** move house (mudar de casa), change jobs (mudar de emprego), get married (casar-se), have a baby (ter um bebê), retire (aposentar-se), start a business (abrir um negócio), quit smoking (parar de fumar), lose weight (perder peso).

items: "I'm very exhausted." O certo é **I'm exhausted** ou **I'm really exhausted.**
"I'm excited with the trip." O certo é excited **about** the trip.

exercises.prompt: After the long drive I was ___. (tired, versão forte)
My boss was very furious yesterday.
acc: My boss was absolutely furious yesterday

exercises.prompt: She ___ house last month and now lives near her parents.

exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.

lessons.title: For, since e present perfect continuous
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Present perfect com for / since; present perfect continuous (How long...?).

head: Present perfect simple
Present perfect continuous
rows: atividade que continua ou acabou de parar, foco na duração
I've lived here for ten years.
I've been working here since 2020. I've been waiting for an hour.

aula.text: **for** = período (for two years, for an hour). **since** = ponto de partida (since 2019, since Monday, since I was a child).
**Pergunta:** How long have you been learning English? / How long have you lived here?

aula.label: Atenção
aula.text: verbos de estado (know, have, be, like) não usam continuous: *I've known him for years.*

items: "I live here since 2019." e "I'm learning English since 3 years." O certo é **I've lived here since 2019** e **I've been learning English for three years.**
"I have been knowing him." O certo é **I've known him.**

exercises.prompt: We've known each other ___ ten years.
I'm studying English since last year.
acc: I've been studying English since last year
I have been studying English since last year

exercises.prompt: I have been knowing him for years.
acc: I have known him for years

lessons.title: Inglês prático, reencontrar alguém
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Reencontrar alguém e conversar (small talk).

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Long time no see! / It's so good to see you! / How have you been?
What have you been up to? / How's work? / How's your family?
Not bad, thanks. / Great, actually! / Busy, as usual. / I've just started a new job.
Really? That's great! / No way! / Good for you.
It was great to catch up. / Let's keep in touch. / Say hi to your family for me.

aula.label: Cuidado
aula.text: *How do you do?* é só para a primeira apresentação, não para reencontros. Use **How have you been?**

exercises.prompt: Responda a "How have you been?" contando uma mudança recente.
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.
